audit_scope: Original artifacts read only; only this new discovery.json is written. No PDF parsing/rendering, model import, network, APIs, pickle loads, or outcome-based sampling.

cache_schema.partition_elements: JSON array in saved parser order; each object has type, element_id, text, metadata
cache_schema.metadata: filename, file_directory, page_number, coordinates, optional detection_class_prob, filetype, languages, last_modified; all detected Tables have text_as_html
cache_schema.raw_tables: Exact ordered subset where type == Table
cache_schema.text_chunks: JSON array of content/metadata documents; initial single-paper run uses text instead of content; NarrativeText/Title only, 2000 characters / 200 overlap
cache_schema.table_documents: Caption plus flattened Table.text; no HTML metadata or HTML content
cache_schema.image_limitation: 162 Image elements; no embedded image_base64; full elements are complete cached parser output, not visual PDF reconstruction

reconstruction_protocol.body_join: Retain saved element order; group by page_number; join text with one space; retain insertion order of first encountered page
reconstruction_protocol.table_method: Use Table.text and identical previous/next FigureCaption or text[:5]==Table selection; previous wins; captions deduplicated by exact text; preserve original negative-index and IndexError behavior
reconstruction_protocol.parity: Compare full list of reconstructed table documents with baseline source_documents filtered by metadata.type == Table using exact Python equality on content and metadata, retaining order
reconstruction_protocol.full_content_character_definition: Sum of content lengths over reconstructed page-text docs plus reconstructed table docs; excludes any eventual prompt framing or separators

selection.eligible_rule: All required original artifacts/hash checks, full cached page coverage, completed baseline artifacts, and exact whole-table parity
selection.length_metric: Sum of .text lengths of all non-Table cached elements
selection.algorithm: rng=random.Random(20261029); one rng.choice of paper_id-sorted candidates from each stratum in order short_light, short_heavy, long_light, long_heavy; then one rng.choice from sorted remaining eligible papers
